DOP: 1 gopeti, gopayati ( and gopati), pr. 3 sg. [ S. gopayati], guards, protects; preserves, keeps safe; covers, closes ; Dhātup 181 (gupa rakkhaṇe); Dhātum 260 (gupa gopanake); 261 (gupa saṃvaraṇe); Vin I 295, 26 (atikhuddakaṃ nisīdanaṃ na sabbaṃ senāsanaṃ ~eti); III 139, 27 (māturakkhitā nāma mātā rakkhati ~eti issariyaṃ kāreti vasaṃ vatteti; Sp 555, 2 : ~etī ti yathā aññe na passanti evaṃ guttaṭṭhāne ṭhapeti); Dhp 315 (evaṃ ~etha attānaṃ); Ja II 34, 25´ (te bhagavanto maṃ pālentu rakkhantu ~entu); IV 448, 21* (te rakkhati ~ayat’ appamatto; 448, 25´ : vatiṃ katvā ~ayati); V 330, 12* (yaṃ ca mātu dhanaṃ hoti yaṃ ca hoti pitū dhanaṃ ubhayaṃ etassa ~eti); Ap 555, 8 (sāliṃ ~em’ ahaṃ tadā); Cp 2:7:4 (yadi ’haṃ tassa pakuppeyyaṃ yadi sīlaṃ na ~aye); Nidd I 262, 30 (ime maṃ rakkhissanti ~issanti samparivārissantī ti); 368, 6 (rakkheyya ~eyya pidaheyya); Mil 151, 26 (parittaṃ rakkhati ~eti); Sp 691, 11 (so ce vadati ~ayissāmi bhante guttaṭṭhānaṃ dassethā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~ayissāma); Sv 1013, 18 (imāni dve dhutaṅgāni pūreti ~eti); Ps I 27, 8 (ayādīni mamāyati rakkhati ~ayati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se gopāyati); Dhp-a I 300, 8 (tvaṃ pi cittaṃ ~ehi); IV 117, 15 (attānaṃ saṃyamaya ~aya); Sadd 403, 16 (gupa rakkhaṇe: ~ati gopako); 403, 23 (gupa gopanajigucchanesu: ~ati jigucchati); — part.pr. ( a ) gopenta, mfn. , Vin III 53, 1 (āhaṭaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ ~ento); Nidd I 130, 24 (cittaṃ … rakkhantā ~entā caranti); ( b ) gopaya(t), mfn. , Th 729 (indriyāni ca ~ayaṃ); Nidd I 155, 18 (tassa evaṃ rakkhato ~ayato te bhogā vippalujjanti); ( c ) gopayanta, mfn. , Nidd-a I 280, 34 (~ayantassa); Mhv 4:32 (satthussa no gandhakuṭiṃ ~ayantā); ( d ) gopayamāna, mfn. , Vism 574, 4 (sandiṭṭhike vā pana kāme patthayamāno paṭiladdhe ca ~ayamāno); Nidd-a I 255, 24 ; — aor. 1 sg. ( a ) gopesiṃ, Ap-a 559, 25 ; ( b ) gopayiṃ, agopayiṃ, Ap 74, 17 (uggayha tīṇi saraṇe paripuṇṇāni ~ayiṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~ayaṃ, prob. wr ); 74, 22 (tāvatā saraṇāgamanaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ agopayiṃ); 3 pl. gopayiṃsu, Dhp-a III 488, 9 ; — inf. ( a ) gopetuṃ, Vin III 65, 13 (~etuṃ ime issarā na-y-ime dātun ti); ( b ) gopayituṃ, Dhp-a III 488, 10 ; ( c ) gopituṃ, Th-a III 22, 24 (rakkhituṃ ~ituṃ na sakkoti); — absol. ( a ) gopetvā, gopitvā, Ap 77, 13 (paripuṇṇāni ~etvā pañcasikkhāpadān’ ahaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~itvā); Mil 360, 7 ; Sp 358, 2 (jaggitvā ~etvā); 386, 7 (te rakkhitvā ~etvā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~itvā); ( b ) gopiya, Ap 75, 29 (paggayha tīṇi saraṇe pañcasīlāni ~iya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~aya, prob. wr ); — pass. pr. 3 sg. gopīyati, Pj I 217, 11 (nidhīyatī ti nidhi, ṭhapīyati rakkhīyati ~īyatī ti attho); — pp gopita , mfn. [ ts ], 1. guarded, protected; defended, kept safe ; Abh 754 (rakkhitaṃ ~aṃ guttaṃ); Vin II 184, 18 (so kho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ rakkhito ~o pi santo bhīto … viharāmi); III 46, 33 (yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ … rakkhitaṃ ~aṃ mamāyitaṃ; Sp 301, 32 : mañjūsādisu pakkhipitvā ~-ttā ~aṃ); Ap-a 381, 21 ; — 2. guarded, watchful; controlled ; Nidd I 221, 5 (vācāyato ti yatto pariyatto gutto ~o rakkhito vūpasanto); — neg. agopita, mfn. , not guarded, not protected; not controlled ; Vism 22, 5 (sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ arakkhitaṃ agopitam eva hoti); Mp I 54, 13 (aguttan ti agopitaṃ sati-saṃvararahitaṃ); III 270, 2 (indriyehi apihitehi agopitehi); — sugopita, mfn. , well-guarded; well protected; well-controlled ; Ap 75, 21 (sugopitaṃ me saraṇaṃ); Ja VI 458, 12 ; Mil 345, 24 (bhagavato dhamma-nagaraṃ … evaṃ surakkhitaṃ evaṃ sugopitaṃ); Vism 22, 13 ; Dhp-a III 331, 7 (te idhalokasmiṃ suparisaṃvutā surakkhitā sugopitā supihitadvārā ti); — fpp ( a ) gopetabba, mfn. , Vin V 125, 18 (atthi parikkhāro rakkhitabbo gopetabbo mamāyitabbo paribhuñjitabbo); Ja I 8, 34 (yathā hi naṃ [sāṭakaṃ] paccatthikā na gaṇhanti tathā gopetabbo hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee gopetabbaṃ) = Ap-a 10, 15 ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce gopetabbaṃ); ( b ) gopitabba, mfn. , Saddh 398 (idaṃ durakkhaṃ gopitabban ti); — see also gutta, gopāyati, jigucchati.
NCP: pr. 3 sg guards; protects; watches, keeps safe; covers, closes.
